issues: This printed CXLI source starts PDF644 middle after Haly causes and ends PDF645 before numbered CXLII religion; do not mix source claims from different chapters.
The historical positive branch requires potent journey significators, benefic aspects OR essential domicile. Personal travel safety cannot be inferred from such testimony.
Prosperity, friendship, honor and travel free of danger are distinct subjective or objective outcomes, relative to source social class, not independent accuracy replications.
Negative cases depend on weak travel signifiers, malefic aspects and accidental positions/house rulership. Pronoun scope is unclear in one malefic 'their Houses' passage.
Travel trouble, imprisonment, criminal acts, loss of money, family betrayal, military harm and physical injury are different risk targets without observations or time windows.
Moist, fixed except Scorpio, movable, humane, bestial, watery and Scorpio classifications have distinct old danger taxonomies and many alternative or overlapping hazards.
Drowning is claimed under a COMPUND condition of watery travel signifier AND malefic affliction AND violent fixed stars; fixed-star identities/orbs not specified.

The source specifically excludes Scorpio from fixed-Saturn fall/storm case, then gives a separate alleged flux/poison case. Do not generalize all Saturn-fixed signs as identical or issue medical advice.
Saturn with ninth ruler in twelfth and ninth ruler in Saturn's domicile are DIFFERENT source cases associated with murder vs theft. No real person danger warning is justified.

The internal fortunate-regions section assigns historic zodiac Signs to Kingdoms and Cities by houses, planets and nodes. No reproducible country geometry or modern geographic baseline follows from the text.
Original source positive glyph after Jupiter/Venus and negative after Saturn/Mars is not fully deciphered, and cannot be guessed as a particular North/South Node for runtime.
The source explicitly refers to Part I printed page 93 for country-to-zodiac mapping. That separate table is NOT collated here.

The 'avoid' rule includes alleged adverse seventh/sixth/eighth/fourth-house signs, malefic occupation and absent Jupiter/Venus benefic aspect; do not apply as actual travel destination planning or religious judgment.
No real birth-verified travel itineraries, danger or death registries, injuries, relative wealth data, actual destination choices or base-rate controls were used.
The image-based packet contains short qualified source paraphrases and checksums, not a full diplomatic original transcription.
